text:
Notify is a working implementation exploring the "Phoenix Architecture" (code is disposable cache; contracts + evaluations are the durable layer). It is a notification-routing system: signals arrive over HTTP, get matched against user-defined rules, and matches are streamed live to a browser via SSE. Everything runs in a single Go process with an in-memory bus — no Docker, no cloud.

Three services, wired in-process via pkg/bus:
1. Ingestor (:8080) — accepts incoming notifications over HTTP
2. Rule API (:8081) — CRUD for delivery rules (source_app / source_account / title, each supporting exact match, glob, or wildcard), backed by SQLite
3. Deliver + Web (:8082) — matches notifications against rules and streams matches to the browser via SSE

pkg/contracts holds the durable notification.v1 and Rule structs (the conserved layer). evaluations/ holds the contract + property tests that define correct behaviour — the implementation in internal/ is the disposable part. CLI helpers: bin/notify (send test notifications), bin/rules (manage rules), bin/serve (run everything and open the web UI).
